_readme: What each authored museum slot can hold. Derived from commons/data/template_patterns.json — regenerate with tools/slot_capacity.py after any tile change. Capacity uses the same centring and wall-flush rules as tools/spatial_contract.masks and tools/spatial_negotiation.origin_for, so a slot's advertised size is the size the negotiator will actually place there. `series` groups adjacent like slots a DNA family or a related-artifact collation can claim together.
